about: Each Dashboard Offline UI suite's minutes in its group's job on a runner of median speed, beside another suite (packages/E2E/Scripts/RunUiSuites.js runs a group's suites two at a time): the median, over the App Test runs below where it passed, of the minutes from its '▶ npm run <suite>' to its '✓ <suite> passed in' (the run step's summary gives them to 0.1), its bundle build included. Where no other suite ran beside it for part of that time - a group's last minutes, or a long suite's in a group that held little else - that part counts 1.26 times over, as long as it would have taken beside another. A suite run in parts has one entry per part, '<suite> <i>/<n>', as its groups' <name>_shard say.

1.26 is how much longer a suite takes beside another than alone: the median, over 68 runs of the 37 suites unchanged between them, of a suite's minutes two at a time on the runs below (beside another for at least 90% of them) to its minutes one at a time on 14.3.0's gate runs (43934059780 and 43895788313, the median of the two).

Event Overview's thirds and Security Operations' halves, split on 2026-11-17, come from its halves' and its whole's runs below, test by test - each part's tests' times and a run's start, counted 1.26 times over as run alone - until App Test's runs measure them.
A new suite's minutes come from a local run (CI=1, its bundle built, nothing else running), times 1.26, until App Test's runs measure it.
Journeys' two guided journeys of 2026-11-18 (#7141, 21.6 s locally) are added to its minutes the same way, times 1.26: 4.4 to 4.9, until App Test's runs measure it.

The status page and telemetry guided setups' two looks at Logs' setup dialog of 2026-11-18 (#7760, #6876, 18.6 s locally) are added to its minutes the same way, times 1.26: 2.9 to 3.3, until App Test's runs measure it.

The status page and telemetry guided setups' suite also measures a status page's Resources grid since 2026-11-18 (StatusPageResourcesGrid.spec.ts, #7239, #7430: 20 tests, 57.2 s locally beside its fixture, built once): added to its minutes the same way, times 1.26, 3.3 to 4.5, until App Test's runs measure it.

The status page theme suite's checks of 2026-11-18 - a page with no logo named in its header, and Not monitored's contrast (StatusPageName.spec.ts, #7467, #6989: 11 tests, 13.5 s locally) - are added to its minutes the same way, times 1.26: 4.8 to 5.1, until App Test's runs measure it.

Tests/Ops/DashboardOfflineUiBudget holds every group of .github/workflows/test.app.yaml's dashboard-offline-ui to ending within 22 minutes on its run step's two lanes, its suites started at these minutes as RunUiSuites.js starts them.
